## Game

"Sazón: Ruta de las Leyendas" — a cooking/card game jam game. The player combines ingredient
cards to cook recipes across levels themed on Latin-American legends:
- **Tutorial** — La Llorona (teaches cooking)
- **Nivel 1** — México (El Ahuizotl)
- **Nivel 2** — Colombia (Hombre Caimán)

Recipe role rule: at most 1 Base + 1 Complemento + 1 Sazón per recipe. Card results:
Star / Normal / Presented / Fail / Cursed / Filler.

## Architecture & Conventions

- **Minimal MonoBehaviour + ScriptableObject data** architecture — no DI container, no event bus.
  This is deliberate (jam scope); do not introduce speculative abstractions.
- **Data-driven content**: recipes, decks, levels, markets and game-loop tuning are
  ScriptableObjects; art is assigned in the Inspector via a `art` sprite slot (no code changes).
- **Scene-per-flow**: each screen is its own scene, driven by a controller script.
- **Pure logic is separated** from Unity presentation where possible (e.g. `RecipeResolver`,
  `RecipeData`, `GameSession`) — these are the fast EditMode-testable units.
- **Namespace/assembly**: no `.asmdef` files exist; all runtime code compiles into
  `Assembly-CSharp`, editor code into `Assembly-CSharp-Editor`.
- **Conventions source**: `.atl/skill-registry.md` (project gates) and
  `.agents/skills/unity-rapid-prototyping/SKILL.md` (gameplay workflow + Decision Gate).

## Testing Capabilities

**Strict TDD Mode**: enabled (test runner detected)

| Capability | Status | Tool / Command |
|------------|--------|----------------|
| Test runner | ✅ | Unity Test Framework 1.6.0 (`com.unity.test-framework`) |
| Test assemblies | ❌ none yet | No `*.asmdef` — must create `Assets/Tests/EditMode` first |
| Unit (EditMode) | ✅ available | `unityMCP run_tests(mode="EditMode")` |
| Integration (PlayMode) | ✅ available | `unityMCP run_tests(mode="PlayMode")` |
| E2E | ❌ | Not installed |
| Coverage | ❌ | `com.unity.coverage` not in manifest |
| Performance tests | ✅ package | `com.unity.test-framework.performance` 3.2.0 |
| Linter | ❌ | None configured (C#; IDE via Rider/VS packages) |
| Type checker | ❌ | Compiler only |
| Formatter | ❌ | None configured |

**Test command**: via Unity MCP bridge —
`unityMCP run_tests(mode="EditMode")` then poll `get_test_job(job_id)`.

**Notes / gotchas**
- Unity Test Framework requires a **test assembly** (`.asmdef` with `TestAssemblies` reference)
  to discover and run tests. None exist yet — the first TDD task must create one.
- EditMode tests need no Play Mode; prefer pure-logic classes for fast feedback.
- Gameplay *feel* is validated via Play Mode + screenshots (`manage_editor`, `manage_camera
  screenshot`), not unit tests — per `unity-rapid-prototyping`.
- Always `read_console` after script changes before running tests/play mode.

## Conventions & Gates (from `.atl/skill-registry.md`)

- Gameplay-first: validate the core loop before architecture or polish.
- Apply the Decision Gate (core-loop value, <1h feasibility, 10x-simpler, asset-over-custom, finishability).
- Prefer one scene, plain MonoBehaviours, direct references, placeholders; no speculative DI/event-bus.
- Validate Unity MCP prerequisites and packages before building; check console after script changes.
- Validate logic with EditMode/PlayMode tests; gameplay with play mode/screenshots.
- If a mechanic is not fun after one focused iteration, kill or simplify it.
- Commits: work-unit commits (by deliverable behavior/fix, not file type), conventional commits,
  no `Co-Authored-By` trailers.

## CI Build Reference

`release.yml` (manual dispatch) — validate SemVer tag from `main`, then parallel builds:
Windows (IL2CPP, custom image `...-il2cpp-3.2.2`), Android (ubuntu, debug APK), WebGL.
Publishes a GitHub Release and deploys Windows/Android/WebGL channels to itch.io.
**CI-only**: removes `com.unity.ai.assistant` + `com.unity.ai.inference` from the manifest
(they crash the headless container). Local manifest keeps them.
